# Build: land-batch-merge-main-each-finished

## Brett said (verbatim)
At: 2026-11-13T23:39:26.785Z
> what else finished; land it

## What to build
Continue build "Land batch: merge main into each finished build and land" (land-batch-merge-main-each-finished) — Phase 1, model Opus.
What Brett asked for (build-origin@1, his words come first; a paraphrase never replaces them):
Brett said (2026-11-13 23:39):
"what else finished; land it"
Model switches: a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. Fable upgrades need no approval right now (Brett, Nov 4 2026: "If it needs Fable, set it to be Fable"): a step that needs Fable (schemas, asset types, contracts, engines/kernel, cross-app protocols) is set to Fable and runs on Fable; the switch is recorded on the build. Never launch a step on a higher model than it is pinned to: raise the step first.
Rules: stay in this one session; no sub-agents; steps ≤ 10 min; read only the files listed; stop at the end of this phase.
Checkpoints: Steps are checkpoints inside this ONE session, not separate tasks: work through them in order without stopping between them; when a step is finished, commit it on your branch, push, then tick it done before starting the next. Nothing is lost if the session dies: the next session picks up at the first open step on the same branch. Never ask for a new prompt or a relaunch per step.
Look: UI code (handwritten or generated) conforms to the hot-swappable asset system: every colour, size, spacing, font, radius and border comes from asset tokens (--fx-* colour/style, --fx-type-* / --fx-dens-* / --fx-size-* scale, --fx-radius-*, --fx-border-w; Kotlin: Axf.colors / Axf.type / Axf.space / Axf.shapes), framework controls instead of raw ones, no var() fallbacks. `node framework/cli/check-theme.mjs` and `check-controls.mjs` must pass (CI fails otherwise); `node framework/cli/scale-adopt.mjs <path>` moves most literals onto the tokens.
API: Everything comes with an API (Brett, Nov 8 2026): anything this build adds or changes that has a UI gets full API control: a deep link that opens it (console_show / console_open target), its state readable, and every action and setting it offers callable without the UI, through the console API (REST), MCP tools (console actions, plugin commands, control@1 for tokens and planner items), the CLI and voice (AmberX), all four the same. A UI-only feature is not done; say in the PR how each one is reached.
Steps in this phase (19 left, ~3.1 h):
[ ] s1 (~8 min) Read /opt/axf-batch/resolve.py and the repo's generated-files@1 resolver (framework/cli + framework/core generated-files logic). Write down the regenerate command for each generated file (axf.lock.json, control/inventory.json, help framework.json) in a notes block of _claude/builds/reports/land-batch-merge-main-each-finished.md, then commit it
[ ] s2 (~10 min) Wire /opt/axf-batch/resolve.py to call the repo's generated-files@1 resolver from the checkout it is landing, and drop its own copy of the logic. A clash in a generated file is then regenerated from the merged sources and staged. A real source clash still stops with the file list. Commit the change to the repo copy that axHub deploys (deploy/ or a framework/cli wrapper) and note the path in the report
[ ] s3 (~10 min) Test the resolver on a scratch worktree: make a clash in axf.lock.json, control/inventory.json and help framework.json and confirm all three are regenerated with no abort. Make a source-file clash and confirm it still stops. Add this as a check script under framework/spec, run it and commit
[ ] s4 (~10 min) toolbar-widgets-attach-any-banner-style: merge origin/main into the branch and regenerate the generated files with the resolver. For a real source clash, keep both sides. Run the branch's tests and the CI sweep (validate, tracker --check, check-theme, check-controls, check-toolbars), push, link the PR with builds-live.mjs link, and record the result in the report
[ ] s5 (~10 min) icon-map-icon-packs-every-icon-badge-app: merge origin/main, regenerate generated files, keep both sides of any source clash, run tests and the CI sweep, push, link the PR, record the result
[ ] s6 (~10 min) token-registry-skin-editor-live-sandbox: merge origin/main, regenerate generated files, keep both sides of any source clash, run tests and the CI sweep (including check-skin.mts and check-skin-coverage), push, link the PR, record the result
[ ] s7 (~10 min) per-instance-settings-small-live-preview: merge origin/main, regenerate generated files, keep both sides of any source clash, run tests and the CI sweep, push, link the PR, record the result
[ ] s8 (~10 min) skin-axhub-override-switch-greyed-out: merge origin/main, regenerate generated files, keep both sides of any source clash, run tests and the CI sweep with the skin checks, push, link the PR, record the result
[ ] s9 (~10 min) skin-animations-swatches-skin-switch: merge origin/main, regenerate generated files, keep both sides of any source clash, run tests and the CI sweep with the skin checks, push, link the PR, record the result
[ ] s10 (~10 min) skin-config-panel-merge-main-and-land: merge origin/main, regenerate generated files, keep both sides of any source clash, run tests and the CI sweep with the skin checks, push, link the PR, record the result
[ ] s11 (~10 min) skins-plugin-merge-main-and-land: merge origin/main, regenerate generated files, keep both sides of any source clash, run tests, the CI sweep and the plugin-lifecycle check, push, link the PR, record the result
[ ] s12 (~10 min) full-voice-control-resolve-inventory: merge origin/main, regenerate control/inventory.json and the other generated files, keep both sides of any source clash, run tests, the CI sweep and check-console-control.mjs, push, link the PR, record the result
[ ] s13 (~10 min) orchestrator-custom-groups-custom-tabs: merge origin/main, regenerate generated files, keep both sides of any source clash, run tests, the CI sweep, check-builds-store and check-chrome-assets, push, link the PR, record the result
[ ] s14 (~10 min) demo-pipelines-guided-walkthrough-live: merge origin/main, regenerate generated files, keep both sides of any source clash, run tests, the CI sweep and the glossary-index catalog --check, push, link the PR, record the result
[ ] s15 (~10 min) console-app-wake-word-voice-listener: merge origin/main, regenerate generated files, keep both sides of any source clash, run tests and the CI sweep, push, link the PR, record the result
[ ] s16 (~10 min) hotfix-desktop-console-draws-app-menu: merge origin/main, regenerate generated files, keep both sides of any source clash, run the PR #658 regression test and the CI sweep, push, link the PR, record the result
[ ] s17 (~10 min) Land: put every green branch's PR into the merge queue as one stack in the order above (land.mjs queue add, or vps.build_land, which now uses the fixed resolver). Merge nothing by hand. If a PR's CI did not start, dispatch it once. Record each queued, merged or kicked-out PR in the report
[ ] s18 (~8 min) After the stack merges, redeploy the console once (axf console refresh --hard or the deploy script, logged with axf_deploy_log). Confirm the console answers and record that in the report
[ ] s19 (~10 min) Finish: run the resolver check, builds-store verify and tracker --check on main. Finish the report _claude/builds/reports/land-batch-merge-main-each-finished.md with each branch's result (landed, clash kept both sides, failed and why). Mark each landed build complete with its PR, update the THREADS.md row, and open the PR for the resolve.py wiring
Read first: /opt/axf-batch/resolve.py, framework/cli, framework/core, _claude/builds/reports/land-batch-merge-main-each-finished.md, deploy, framework/spec, axf.lock.json, control/inventory.json, help, apps/console-web/plugins, apps/console-web/plugins/build-orchestrator, apps/console-web, apps/console-web/plugins/push-banner/land, _claude/THREADS.md, _claude/builds/store.json
Tick each step right after its commit: node apps/console-web/plugins/build-orchestrator/orchestrator.mjs act step land-batch-merge-main-each-finished <stepId> done — it reaches main at once (builds-live). Link your branch / PR: node framework/cli/builds-live.mjs link land-batch-merge-main-each-finished --branch <b> --pr <n>.
Watch live: when you start on a screen, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "…"` so the live preview follows you.
Screenshots that are not for approval (checking a screen, live captures, before/after): axf shot <file> --name "…" --app … --screen … --group "<build name>" (UI Review → Screenshots; ui-review-item@1), never the review queue.

## Pipeline
This session was started by the orchestrator's dispatcher on Claude account mossesx-max- for the Opus phase. Work through every step of the phase in this one session: they are checkpoints, not separate tasks. As each step finishes, commit it on your branch, push, and tick it (orchestrator.mjs act step land-batch-merge-main-each-finished <stepId> done), then go straight on to the next; nothing is lost if the session dies, the next one starts at the first open step on the same branch. When this phase's steps are done, stop: the dispatcher starts the next phase on the right account. If you must stop early with steps left, say why in a build note (orchestrator.mjs act note land-batch-merge-main-each-finished "…"); the build goes back to Pending for Brett.
